page.overview:
Who is Dinosaur Handler?

This park worker was one of the many dinosaur handlers on Isla Nublar in Jurassic World responsible for herding Parasaurolophus, Sinoceratops, Apatosaurus, Ankylosaurus and Stegosaurus to better feeding grounds in the park.
